summary: Full frontend regression test for ArcaLink iteration 2. All 7 test items from the review request PASSED. Fixes from iteration 1 verified working: back button, logout without error overlay, and display name updates. Minor residual: when Dr. João views conversation list, Maria's contact still shows email address until CometChat syncs her updated name from her own login session.

integration_issues.issue: MINOR: When Dr. João is logged in, Maria's contact name in conversation list still shows 'maria.silva@email.c...' (email) until CometChat syncs the name update from Maria's own login. From Maria's view, Dr. João's name shows correctly as 'Dr. João Silva'. This is a CometChat cache sync delay, not a code bug — updateCurrentUserDetails is called correctly at login.

issues: Group 'Pre-Natal - Maria Silva' shows 'P-' as avatar initials (taking P from 'Pre' and '-' from hyphen). This is a CometChat avatar generation behavior, not a custom code issue.
When Dr. João views chat with Maria, header shows 'maria.silva@email.com' (email) instead of 'Maria Silva'. This is the same CometChat sync issue as the conversation list contact name.

critical_code_review_comments: All 3 critical fixes from iteration 1 verified working: (1) chat-back-btn added, (2) setTimeout 150ms in handleLogout prevents unmount error, (3) CometChat.updateCurrentUserDetails() updates name after login.

Contact name sync: The updateCurrentUserDetails() call updates the logged-in user's own name. The contact's name visible to other users is fetched from CometChat server and may be cached. This is expected CometChat behavior.
mocked_apis: Login flow is MOCKED — email→UID mapping in LoginPage.js MVP_USERS object, password validated locally, no backend auth. CometChatUIKit.login(uid) used for actual chat session.

context_for_next_testing_agent: ArcaLink medical chat app using CometChat UIKit v4 React. All 3 critical bugs from iteration 1 are now fixed and verified. App uses PhoneMockup wrapper. CometChat message input selector: '.cometchat-message-composer__input' (contenteditable=plaintext-only). Send button: '.cometchat-message-composer__send-button'. Back button: data-testid='chat-back-btn'. Login page has .demo-chip.medico and .demo-chip.paciente for quick login. Minor residual: contact name shows email for Dr. João's view of Maria until CometChat syncs.

contact_name_sync.root_cause: updateCurrentUserDetails() updates the logged-in user's own CometChat profile. When User A views User B's contact name, it reads from CometChat's cached conversation metadata. If User B just updated their name in this session, User A's conversation list may show the old name until CometChat server propagates the update.
contact_name_sync.impact: LOW - name updates correctly once the other user logs in and both are active
contact_name_sync.status: NOT A CODE BUG — CometChat server sync behavior
